# Recreation Prompt

Build a portrait-first browser-native alien shooter called **Alien Shooter: EZ Clap Netwar 2000**. Preserve the implemented top-down survival shooter mechanics: touch-drag movement, auto-fire at nearest alien, enemy pursuit/contact damage, projectile hits, enemy drops, score/heal pickups, HP defeat, and restart. Present the world as a satirical vaporwave/Y2K internet arena with chrome UI, meme copy (“ez clap”, “goated”), cyberpunk synthwave colors, readable mobile HUD, and short commute-session flow.

Primary user steering: Alien Shooter. A satirical game inspired by vaporwave Y2K internet culture built around alien shooter play, with competitive, futuristic, multiplayer energy, commute friendly session design, search-friendly hooks like alien shooter, shooter, arcade, aesthetics like synthwave, cyberpunk, chrome aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as ez clap, goated. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: top-down mobile arcade shooter / survival arena
- objective: survive enemy waves, auto-shoot pursuers, collect drops for score and healing
- input model: pointer/touch drag anywhere on the canvas to steer; firing is automatic
- core loop: start run, enemies spawn, player kites while auto-firing, enemies drop pickups, score and HP update, HP zero opens restart
- fail/friction state: enemy contact drains HP until game over; restart returns to a fresh run

## Protected mechanics
- Canvas arena with camera following player
- Drag-anywhere pointer movement with joystick vector and one-thumb play
- Automatic firing at nearest enemy inside target range every 300ms
- Enemies spawn at distance, pursue player, and cause continuous contact damage
- Bullets damage enemies; defeated enemies drop collectibles
- Collectibles magnetize, increment score by one, and heal player by five
- HP reaches zero to enter game-over; restart resets run

## Remixed target
Alien Shooter. A satirical game inspired by vaporwave Y2K internet culture built around alien shooter play, with competitive, futuristic, multiplayer energy, commute friendly session design, search-friendly hooks like alien shooter, shooter, arcade, aesthetics like synthwave, cyberpunk, chrome aesthetic, and meme-tone cues such as ez clap, goated. Designed for one-thumb mobile play with touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, fast onboarding, and portrait-first UX tuned for iOS and Android in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The rebuilt surface reframes the same mechanics as a satirical Y2K vaporwave alien-shooter match: the chrome pilot strafes through a neon internet arena, pop-up aliens rush the player, auto-fire posts laser replies, and clout shards are collected for score/healing.
